description:
Several public user-visible types use ad-hoc display() methods instead of impl std::fmt::Display, which prevents use with format strings, log macros, and error chains:

kith-core/src/auth.rs: Identity has a pub fn display(&self) -> &str method (line 32) instead of impl Display. Callers must call .display() explicitly; they cannot use {id} in format strings, only {}.

Note: AuthError and KithError do use thiserror #[derive(Error)] so Display is generated for those.

Fix: implement std::fmt::Display for Identity (delegating to the existing display() logic), then deprecate or remove the display() method. This allows Identity values to be used directly in format strings and log macros.
title: Missing Display impl on user-visible types
